## What this is

The chat page polls this while a monthly update runs, to draw the progress bar and deliver the saved result when the run finishes. It reads one row from `update_runs` and does nothing else — no Gmail read, no model call, no cost.

It answers on `/webhook/monthly-update-progress`, and the chat app asks it a few times a minute, which is why this workflow keeps no execution history: saving every successful poll would bury the executions that matter.
